pr.title: feat(upsampling) - Support upsampled error count with performance optimizations

raw_findings.body: The errors dataset config does not define the upsampled_count function (it is only added to DiscoverDatasetConfig here), so the query raises InvalidSearchQuery and the error-upsampled stats request fails.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Runtime query resolution fails with an unknown-function error on the errors dataset.
raw_findings.impact: The errors dataset config does not define the upsampled_count function (it is only added to DiscoverDatasetConfig here), so the query raises InvalidSearchQuery and the error-upsampled stats request fails.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new aggregation function was added to only one of the dataset configs that the transform can target.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Register the upsampled_count SnQLFunction on the errors dataset config (ErrorsDatasetConfig) as well, or otherwise ensure every dataset for which _should_apply_sample_weight_transform can return True supports upsampled_count.
raw_findings.title: upsampled_count only registered on discover dataset, not errors dataset
raw_findings.trigger: A query hits the errors dataset (the primary path where _should_apply_sample_weight_transform returns True unconditionally) with all projects allowlisted, so count() is rewritten to 'upsampled_count() as count' and executed against the errors dataset builder.

raw_findings.body: The upsampling decision and the column transformation are computed from the outer `dataset` rather than the `scoped_dataset` actually being queried, so the wrong dataset can be transformed (or the correct one skipped), producing incorrect counts.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Transformation applied to a mismatched dataset, yielding wrong or failed query results in the split path.
raw_findings.impact: The upsampling decision and the column transformation are computed from the outer `dataset` rather than the `scoped_dataset` actually being queried, so the wrong dataset can be transformed (or the correct one skipped), producing incorrect counts.
raw_findings.root_cause: The eligibility check anchors on the endpoint-level dataset, ignoring the per-call scoped dataset parameter.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Pass `scoped_dataset` (the dataset actually executing the query) into is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects instead of the closure `dataset`.
raw_findings.title: Upsampling eligibility uses closure dataset instead of scoped_dataset
raw_findings.trigger: A dashboard-widget discover-split request invokes get_event_stats_factory, which calls _get_event_stats with scoped_dataset=errors while the closure variable `dataset` is still discover.

raw_findings.body: A stray nested submodule/gitlink is committed with no .gitmodules entry, breaking clean checkouts/submodule init and polluting the repo tree.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Checkout/tooling failures due to an unregistered submodule gitlink.
raw_findings.impact: A stray nested submodule/gitlink is committed with no .gitmodules entry, breaking clean checkouts/submodule init and polluting the repo tree.
raw_findings.root_cause: An unrelated nested repository was staged and committed together with the feature.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Remove the accidental `sentry-repo` gitlink from the commit.
raw_findings.title: Accidental sentry-repo git submodule added
raw_findings.trigger: Cloning or checking out the repository after this patch attempts to resolve the newly added gitlink `sentry-repo` pointing at an arbitrary commit with no configured submodule URL.

raw_findings.body: The invalidation helper is never wired to any allowlist-change hook, so eligibility remains stale for up to 60s and the function is dead code; changes to the allowlist are silently ignored for the cache window.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Stale cached eligibility and unreferenced code with no effect.
raw_findings.impact: The invalidation helper is never wired to any allowlist-change hook, so eligibility remains stale for up to 60s and the function is dead code; changes to the allowlist are silently ignored for the cache window.
raw_findings.root_cause: Cache invalidation path was implemented but not connected to any caller.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Either call invalidate_upsampling_cache from the option-change handler or remove the unused function; do not ship dead invalidation code.
raw_findings.title: invalidate_upsampling_cache defined but never called
raw_findings.trigger: The allowlist option issues.client_error_sampling.project_allowlist is changed while cached eligibility (60s TTL) is live.

raw_findings.body: Count values (integers via toInt64) are typed as number in the response meta, changing the API contract and potentially causing float-formatted counts on the client compared to the untransformed count() integer type.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Response meta type/format regression for upsampled counts.
raw_findings.impact: Count values (integers via toInt64) are typed as number in the response meta, changing the API contract and potentially causing float-formatted counts on the client compared to the untransformed count() integer type.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new aggregation declares a non-integer result type for what remains an integer count.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Set default_result_type="integer" to match count() semantics.
raw_findings.title: upsampled_count declared with default_result_type number instead of integer
raw_findings.trigger: A count() query is upsampled and aliased to `count`, whose meta type is now reported as number rather than integer.

raw_findings.body: The caching behavior (60s TTL, stale results, cache-hit branch returning cached_result) and invalidation are untested, so regressions in the primary public entry point and its cache logic go undetected.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Cache/eligibility regressions merge without test failure.
raw_findings.impact: The caching behavior (60s TTL, stale results, cache-hit branch returning cached_result) and invalidation are untested, so regressions in the primary public entry point and its cache logic go undetected.
raw_findings.root_cause: The main public function and cache path were added without corresponding unit coverage.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add tests exercising is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects cache hit/miss and invalidate_upsampling_cache behavior.
raw_findings.title: No test covers cached is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects
raw_findings.trigger: The unit test imports only the private helpers and transform, omitting is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects and invalidate_upsampling_cache.
